escalations: ILLUSTRATION-SPEC amendment proposal (design/ILLUSTRATION-SPEC.md is shared — not edited): the Psx pillar stroke range 1.5-2.5 assumes split/mosaic/band render sizes (~384-560px). The two ledger-rail emblems (PsxBlackstoneIntel, PsxBlackstoneInvestments) render at only 80-96px, so they deliberately use strokes 5-6 in the 480 viewBox (~1.0-1.2px on screen — optically equivalent to the pillar's fine-line weight). Suggest the spec add a note permitting ledger-scale optical compensation so a later round doesn't 'correct' the weights and make the emblems invisible. The compensation is documented in both files' header comments.

issues.description: Stroke widths 5-6 in a 480 viewBox exceed the Psx spec range 1.5-2.5; defensible optical compensation for the 80-96px ledger rail but undocumented, so a later round could thin them and erase the emblem.
issues.resolution: Strokes NOT thinned. Header comment now documents strokes 5-6 as deliberate optical compensation (~1.0-1.2px rendered, equivalent to the pillar's fine-line weight) with an explicit do-not-correct warning; a matching manifest escalation proposes a spec note for ledger-scale emblems.
